# Polished Mastering

> Online audio mastering studio for Metal & Gothic, based in Lower Saxony, Germany. Every project starts with a full written audio audit of the mix before mastering begins. Mastered personally by Tim Borchert (currently studying Systematic Musicology and Media Studies at the University of Hamburg; two years of event-technician training, live mixing for a rock band, own releases on labels in Mexico, India and Turkey; formerly worked at the Deutsche Stiftung Musikleben, Hamburg). No AI mastering.

Polished specializes in mastering for Black Metal, Death Metal, Doom, Gothic and Metalcore/Djent. Every package includes a full audio audit (frequency spectrum, dynamics and loudness, stereo image and phase, sonic assessment against genre references), a documented mastering plan, and unlimited revisions. Delivery: 24-bit WAV, 16-bit AIFF, 320 kbps MP3, plus streaming and Bandcamp versions. Communication in English or German.

## Services and prices
All prices are final prices including 19% German VAT. No upfront payment required: clients pay on invoice after delivery or up front, their choice.
- Stereo Mastering, single track: €79 (48–72h)
- Stem Mastering, single track, up to 6 stems: €129 (48–72h)
- EP Mastering, up to 5 tracks: €349 (5–7 days; €46 less than 5 singles)
- Album Mastering, up to 10 tracks, vinyl master on request: €629 (7–14 days; €161 less than 10 singles)
- Rush delivery in 24h on request

## Genre pages
- [Black Metal Mastering](https://polished.media/black-metal-mastering/): raw, atmospheric, melodic/symphonic and DSBM; harshness, cymbal wash and low-end control
- [Death Metal Mastering](https://polished.media/death-metal-mastering/): OSDM, technical, brutal/slam, melodic death and deathcore; low-mid weight and blast-beat clarity
- [Doom & Gothic Mastering](https://polished.media/doom-gothic-mastering/): doom, funeral doom, sludge, gothic metal, gothic rock, darkwave; dynamics and low end
- [Metalcore & Djent Mastering](https://polished.media/metalcore-djent-mastering/): extended-range low end, breakdowns, clean/screamed vocals

## Guides
- [Mastering for record labels](https://polished.media/mastering-for-labels/): fixed label partner rates from 4 releases per year (€63 single, €103 stem single, €279 EP, €499 album incl. VAT), audit per track, payment per release
- [Stem mastering guide](https://polished.media/stem-mastering/): stereo vs. stem mastering, when stems are worth it, how to export stems (checklist), prices
- [How much does mastering cost?](https://polished.media/mastering-cost/): market price ranges from AI mastering to renowned studios, Polished prices for single, EP, album, stems
- [How loud should metal be mastered?](https://polished.media/metal-mastering-loudness/): streaming loudness targets by platform (Spotify -14 LUFS, Apple Music about -16 LUFS), typical LUFS ranges by metal subgenre, true-peak limits

## Tools for bands (plugins by Code Chaos Audio)
Tim Borchert also builds audio plugins under the label Code Chaos Audio. Polished only links to them; they are sold and downloaded on Gumroad (timberwolf688.gumroad.com). No AU versions (Logic Pro not supported); macOS builds are Apple Silicon only and not signed or notarized.
- [Tools for bands (overview)](https://polished.media/tools/): all plugins with price, platforms, demo audio
- [Gravesaw](https://polished.media/tools/gravesaw/): black metal amp + cab for guitar and bass DI, 19 built-in cabs, 16 presets; €19, free demo; Windows + macOS (Apple Silicon)
- [Rimehall](https://polished.media/tools/rimehall/): cold reverb, octave shimmer and tape bus with ducking, 14 presets; €19, free demo; Windows + macOS (Apple Silicon)
- [Kick/Bass Scope](https://polished.media/tools/kick-bass-scope/): free beat-synced kick and bass oscilloscope with correlation meter (phase check); Windows + macOS (Apple Silicon)
- [Crucible](https://polished.media/tools/crucible/): 3-band saturation, 5 types per band, oversampling up to 8x; €19, free demo; Windows only
- [Shardstep](https://polished.media/tools/shardstep/): tempo-synced stutter and glitch for 200-300 BPM, 16-step patterns, MIDI trigger; €15, free demo; Windows + macOS (Apple Silicon)
- [Chaos FM](https://polished.media/tools/chaos-fm/): 3-operator FM synth with GENERATE button, 12 presets; €19, free demo; Windows only
- German versions: https://polished.media/de/tools/ (and /de/tools/<plugin>/)

## Bundles and label rates
- Single Series: 3 singles booked together, €73 each, mastered as released over up to 12 months
- Stem EP: up to 5 tracks from stems, €549 (instead of €645)
- Label Partner (from 4 releases per year): single €63, stem single €103, EP €279, album €499
- All prices final, incl. 19% German VAT; payment up front or on invoice after delivery, client's choice
